identity.mission: Create a cinematic, immersive media platform that feels like a personal Netflix but with the power of a server dashboard.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Netflix' cinematic visuals with 'Torrent Client' data density.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel 'premium' and 'curated'.
Content is King: The media art (posters, backdrops) is the UI. The interface should recede.
Zoom In: Use large, immersive backdrops for media details.
Negative Space: Don't clutter the browsing experience; let the posters breathe.

headings.usage: All page titles, section headers, and media titles.

typography.instructions: Import 'Manrope' and 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts in index.css. DO NOT use Inter for headings.

colors.theme_strategy: Dark Mode Only (Cinematic). Light mode is optional but secondary.

textures.noise: Add a fixed, pointer-events-none div with a noise texture at 3% opacity over the entire app to give it a 'film grain' look.

details_page.structure: Full-screen backdrop with gradient overlay. Content floats on top left. 'Cast' and 'Episodes' below fold.

buttons.primary: bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-bold tracking-wide shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(124,58,237,0.3)] transition-all hover:scale-105
buttons.secondary: bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5

cards.info_card: bg-surface border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors

inputs.search: bg-black/20 border border-white/10 rounded-full px-4 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 focus:border-transparent transition-all w-full backdrop-blur-sm

navigation.sidebar: Fixed left, glassmorphism. Icons only on mobile, expanded on desktop hover.

motion.micro_interactions: Buttons should have a subtle 'press' scale (0.98). Icons should glow on hover.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALLATION: Run 'npm install framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge' immediately.
3. THEME: Force Dark Mode by default. Add 'dark' class to the html or body tag initially.
4. LAYOUT: Use a Sidebar Layout (Left fixed, Right content). The Sidebar must be glassmorphic.
5. COMPONENTS: Build a 'MediaCard' component that handles the hover scale and play button overlay. This is the core of the app.
6. PLAYER: The video player should be a custom overlay, not the default HTML5 player. Style the controls.
7. MOCK DATA: Create a robust 'mockData.js' file with the provided image URLs to populate the dashboard immediately. Do not leave it empty.
8. NOISE: Add the noise texture overlay in App.js as a fixed background element.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Dark Colors: Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use them as solid backgrounds with noise.
Spacing: Use p-8 or p-12 for section padding. Don't cramp the media.
Micro-animations: Every hover must have a reaction.
Data-TestId: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
